HTSUS classification for pharmaceutical products: Chapter 29 (organic chemicals) or Chapter 30 (pharmaceutical products).

Diclofenac sodium is an anti-inflammatory drug. In HTSUS, headings:
- 2937: hormones
- 2941: antibiotics
- 3003: Medicaments (not put up in measured doses or in forms/packings for retail)
- 3004: Medicaments (put up in measured doses or in forms or packings for retail)

Diclofenac gel 1% in 100 gram tubes is a retail-packaged medicament, so heading 3004.

- 3004.32: containing other antibiotics
- 3004.39: other (containing hormones or other products of 2937)
- 3004.40: containing alkaloids or derivatives thereof

- 3004.90: other

- 3004.90: Other
